selection_equivalence.interpretation: Both rules are retained; identical selections in this sample are not independent replications.

per_backend_support.interpretation: Observed known support-call cost subtotals only; the old JEV unknown attempt can still have a charge. Reserved allowances are not billed cost. These figures do not establish calibrated task fairness or end-to-end cost advantage.

execution.elapsed_scope: This recovery invocation, including validation and scoring; excludes the earlier interrupted run and gap. No cold-start or throughput ranking is inferred.

limits: All 77 questions and 24 families are exposed development data; not independent confirmation or an official-test result.
The same family draws support all question-weighted and family-balanced estimates; 95% percentile intervals have no multiple-comparison correction.
The primary k remains 3. All k=1 and k=2 sensitivity methods and all same-k comparison directions remain reported.
JEV raw reported scores are not calibrated probabilities. The two score rules selected identical packs in every question at all three k values.
A fixed maximum token and unit budget does not match actual evidence length across methods. Token deltas are retained.
This evaluates support ranking within a frozen candidate pool. It does not establish corpus retrieval, shared document-relation, hierarchy or complete SLAC gains.
JEV ordinal support did not establish an advantage over the general model. Score-versus-general primary intervals include zero.
No final Answer F1 is measured in this support result. Answer generation has a separate complete-result gate.
The original timeout remains a potentially billed unknown attempt. Known reported cost is a subtotal; reservations are conservative admission accounting, not billed cost.
One explicitly documented operational repeat was added after the stopped run. The original failed run and every old reservation remain unchanged.
